focusRing.note: Keyboard focus ring and outline-color on generic chrome controls.

hoverSurface.note: List/table row and panel hover fills matching app-table-hover.

pressedSurface.why: No dedicated --vg-* pressed surface; control gradient bottom may differ on :active.

activeNavigation.note: Active tab/menu item uses the same fill as selection unless proven otherwise.

disabledForeground.why: No --vg-disabled-ink; muted text token is not equivalent for all disabled controls.

disabledBorder.why: No --vg-disabled-border; weakening --vg-border without computed-style proof is unsafe.

controlHoverSurface.note: Button hover gradient stop on generic chrome buttons.
